title: Conditional two-sided history recurrence to all-shape exhaustion Cauchy transfer
question: If the existing two-orientation shell envelope is supplied by a common-domain, two-sided history recurrence, what exact all-shape exhaustion Cauchy bound follows, and does its scalar tail vanish without a finite-table extrapolation?
method: Load the hash-pinned R-450 two-orientation shell-transfer manifest and its primary run; retain the actual-Q3-history and common-domain flags as open.
Define the exact R-444 tail T(R), recompute its base value and step ratio, and prove the sharp ratio envelope 23/26 for R>=1 from the polynomial difference.
Use the declared conditional history contract: one common L4 space/form domain, additive edge decomposition for each orientation, triple-nested consistency, and the R-450 per-edge fourth-power bound.
Derive the root-free total two-orientation bound by the fourth-power sum inequality, giving 16*C4_edge*T(R)^4 for boxes agreeing through radius R-1.
Check the scalar ratio rows R=1..64, an independent non-importing reconstruction, nine hostile mutations, the integrated verifier and Lean R451 arithmetic.
finding: Under the explicit common-domain and two-sided history-recurrence assumptions, the existing R-450 shell interface implies ||Y_Lambda'-Y_Lambda||_L4^4 <= 16*C4_edge*T(R)^4 whenever two nested shapes agree through radius R-1. The exact tail ratio is at most 23/26 from R>=1, so T(R) is bounded by 78*(23/26)^(R-1) and vanishes analytically. Primary passes 341/341, independent 332/332, hostile rejects 9/9, integrated passes 19/19 and Lean R451 compiles. No actual Q3 history, common domain, production exhaustion map or physical/continuum gate is supplied.
decision_reason: This is the next analytic-only T-054 interface after R-450: it advances from a shell envelope to its conditional all-shape Cauchy consequence without adding another finite grid, inventing a source owner, or changing the established proof method and owner order.
boundary: T0 claim-nonbearing conditional recurrence-to-Cauchy transfer only. The history recurrence, common domain, actual production observable and uniform constants remain hypotheses or missing assumptions; no common alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, physical sector, continuum, Yang--Mills or mass-gap conclusion follows.
evidence_level: T0 exact conditional recurrence-to-Cauchy transfer with analytic geometric-tail envelope

adversarial_review.check: The two-sided recurrence is treated as an explicit hypothesis and not as an already supplied Q3 history.
The triangle inequality is used only after one common L4 space or form domain is required.
Agreement through radius R-1 does not by itself identify the production observable or its edge decomposition.
The factor 16 is derived as 8 times the two declared orientations, not fitted.
The 64 scalar rows audit the ratio formula only; no finite table is called an exhaustion theorem.
The result composes R-450 with a conditional consequence and leaves T-054/T-059/T-061 methods and owner order unchanged.
Actual Q3, operator, common-alpha, physical, continuum and Clay flags remain false.

missing_assumptions: A source-owned Q3LOCK history and actual per-edge terms satisfying the R-450 contract.
A common unbounded operator/form domain and a proof that the actual history terms lie in it.
Source-, beta-, cutoff-, volume-, shape-, phase- and history-uniform constants.
A production all-shape exhaustion map and observable identity across shapes.
OS/KMS/GNS identification, common alpha, sector coercivity, physical-empty comparison, continuum, Yang--Mills and mass-gap closure.
next_action: When a source-owned Q3 history and common domain arrive, instantiate the R-451 hypotheses and test the actual all-shape Cauchy estimate. Until then, keep the T-054 owner boundary and additive T-059/T-061 source locks unchanged; do not emit another finite mobility table.
stop_or_redesign: If an actual history term violates the per-edge contract, record the local failure rather than enlarging C4_edge.
If triple-nested decomposition consistency fails, retain the conditional theorem and record shape dependence.
If no common domain is supplied, do not convert the L4 interface into an operator/form result.
If a proposed use changes the established method or owner order, return to the continuity gate.
provenance_note: This is a reusable conditional interface and not a claim-tier change or method replacement.
